item: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W (pre-soldered header)
spec: WH variant avoids soldering the 40-pin header. 512 MB RAM.

item: microSD 32 GB, A1/A2
spec: Raspberry Pi OS Lite 64-bit, headless.

item: Waveshare IMX296 Global Camera (A), SKU 32501
spec: COLOUR sensor with an integrated IR-cut filter (not mono as the design doc assumed). Listed DISCONTINUED on waveshare.com when checked; $82.99 list price. Includes a 15-to-22-pin and a 15-pin CSI cable, the C-CS adapter and a dust cap; no lens. Needs dtoverlay=imx296 (no mono).

item: CSI ribbon cable, 22-pin to 15-pin
spec: Included with the Waveshare camera (the Zero has the small 22-pin port).

item: 16 mm C-mount lens (Waveshare 16 mm telephoto: dia 39 x 50 mm, 134 g, f/1.4-16)
spec: The cradle and dew shield are sized for this lens. Price is my estimate, not checked.

item: NEMA 17 pancake stepper, 20-25 mm body, <=1 A/phase
spec: Run at 0.4-0.6 A. Take 5 mm D-shaft.

item: TMC2209 driver module (SilentStepStick format)
spec: Pick a board that exposes MS1/MS2 so both drivers share one UART via addresses 0 and 1.

item: Micro limit switch with roller lever (KW12-3 class)
spec: 4 used: two per axis. 5 bought, 1 spare. The mounts assume a body of about 20 x 10.5 x 6.5 mm with 9.5 mm hole spacing and a roller lever; confirm on the switches you buy.

item: M2 x 8 self-tapping screws, small pack
spec: Eight hold the four end-stop switches into their pilot holes.

item: Flexible shaft coupler 5 mm to 6 mm
spec: Absorbs the +/-6 deg swing of the screw as the arm turns.

item: M6x1 stainless threaded rod, 1 m
spec: M6 coarse pitch is 1.0 mm: 0.716 deg/turn on an 80 mm arm. Do NOT substitute T8x8 (8 mm lead, back-drives).

item: Brass hex nut M6, pack of 10
spec: Brass on stainless for low friction. Held in a printed trunnion.

item: Extension springs, assorted pack
spec: Anti-backlash preload. Altitude: two springs that suit about 74 mm between hooks when installed. Azimuth: one spring of roughly 25 mm free length and 0.3 N/mm (run cad/check_preload.py with your spring's figures to pick the peg). Buy a pack with a spread of lengths and rates.

item: 608ZZ bearing, pack of 10
spec: Hinge pins and screw-end support.

item: 8 mm ground steel rod, 300 mm
spec: Hinge pins: cut one 124 mm (coarse hinge) and one 140 mm (altitude hinge), 264 mm in all, and chamfer the ends.

item: 6 in aluminium lazy-Susan turntable bearing
spec: Azimuth stage. Watch axial wobble: measure it. Upgrade path is a cross-roller slewing ring.

item: 3/8-16 x 3/4 in (19 mm) hex bolt (the telescope stud)
spec: One used, one spare. The stud stands (length - 11 mm) above the seat disc, so 19 mm gives 8 mm. Measure the depth of your S50's socket first: the stud must stand up less than that, or the telescope will tilt on a bottomed stud. Order 1 in (25 mm) as well if the socket is deeper than 14 mm.

item: 3/8-16 hex nut, standard thickness (about 8.3 mm, 9/16 in across flats)
spec: One sits in the hex pocket of the base spider and threads onto the tripod stud; the spare is for a miscut. Not a coupling nut (those are about 28 mm long and will not fit). Do not rely on a printed 3/8-16 thread.

item: 3/8-16 to 1/4-20 reducer bushing
spec: For photo tripods; also the Dwarf 3 adapter if wanted.

item: Heat-set inserts M3/M4/M5/M6 assortment
spec: Brass, for printed parts.

item: Fastener assortment: M3/M4/M5/M6 socket-head, washers, nuts, 3 mm dowel pins
spec: Stainless where outdoors.

item: Wing nut or star knob M6
spec: Coarse-tilt lock.

item: PETG filament, 1 kg spool
spec: 854 g for every printed part including the coupon; the second spool covers reprints and failed prints. Print with an enclosed X1C/P1S: no PLA (creep).

item: Adhesive felt feet + black flocking paper
spec: Feet, and dew-shield lining.

item: M2.5 heat-set inserts + M2.5 x 8 screws, small pack
spec: Four of each hold the camera board to its plate.

item: Cable ties 2.5 x 100 mm, assorted pack
spec: Hold the PD trigger and buck modules in the case bay, and tidy the wiring.

item: M6 x 130 mm bolt + nut (coarse tilt lock)
spec: Passes through both coarse cheeks and both tilt-plate arms; tighten with a wrench.

item: USB-C PD trigger board, 12 V
spec: Check the power bank really offers 12 V PD; many only offer 9/15/20 V.

item: 12 V to 5 V buck converter, 3 A, low-noise
spec: Pololu D24V22F5 class. Separate 5 V rail for the Pi.

item: 24 AWG silicone wire, ferrules, heat shrink
spec: Motor, end-stop and power harness.

item: ICM-20948 IMU breakout (I2C)
spec: Coarse tilt and knock detection. Compass is a rough guide only.

item: u-blox M8/M9 GNSS breakout with I2C (DDC) pins and antenna
spec: Verify the board exposes SDA/SCL before ordering: many cheap boards are UART-only and the Zero has no spare UART.

item: Carrier PCB, 2-layer ~85x60 mm, 5 pcs (fab order incl. shipping)
spec: Upload pcb/fab/carrier_gerbers.zip. Five is the usual minimum order; shipping dominates the price.

item: Screw terminal 5.08 mm, 2-pin
spec: 12 V in, 12 V to the buck module, 5 V from the buck module.

item: JST-XH kit with crimp pins (2-pin and 4-pin)
spec: 2x 4-pin for motors, 4x 2-pin for end stops, plus the mating housings.

item: 2.54 mm headers: 1x 2x20 female, 4x 1x8 female, 2x 1x5, 1x 1x2 + jumper
spec: Pi socket, TMC2209 sockets, I2C, JP1.

item: PTC resettable fuse, 2 A hold, radial, 5.08 mm lead pitch, rated 30 V or more
spec: One on the 12 V rail, one on the 5 V rail. The TVS clamps near 25 V, so a 16 V-rated PTC is too low on the 12 V rail. Check lead pitch and rating on the part you buy.

item: 1N5822 Schottky + 1.5KE18A TVS
spec: Reverse-polarity and surge protection on the 12 V input.

item: Electrolytic: 1x 220 uF/35 V, 2x 100 uF/35 V
spec: Bulk capacitance at the input and at each driver's VM.

item: 0805 assortment: 100 nF, 1 k, 10 k, red LED
spec: 6 capacitors, 7 resistors, 1 LED. Min packs are far larger than needed.
